_note: Synthetic phrases only (no household data). dev = written with the lexicon and tuned on; held_out_1 and blind_2 were written AFTER the lexicon froze and scored ONCE before any fix (first-run numbers: docs/knowledge/distress-handoff.md); both were then used to fix whole classes of cue, so all three are regression sets now, not blind estimates. ideation_3 (first-person suicidal ideation: thinking about suicide, suicidal thoughts, I feel suicidal; both directions) was written BEFORE its cues, scored on the old lexicon (the bug), then once on the new cues; ideation_3_probe was written after that run and scored once before its class fixes. overdose_4 (intentional overdose: a quantity + an intent marker; accident / third party / past / fiction / idiom on the other side) and overdose_4_probe follow the same method.
